baseline: Both intro and advanced complete single Plains maps, same seed corpus; separately report two-map campaign total
scope: One continuous playable Plains region, not the previous eight-Module sample
selection: First logically admissible design per fixed seed; no selection on holdout or subjective quality score
main_route: Four to eight exploration transitions before boss forecourt; not an authored horizontal spine; final actual cost must be measured
reward_routes: Multiple deep expeditions, distinct entrance/rejoin, earned return shortcut, rewards related to extra actual time and risk
art_gate: Actual main default avatar/runtime installer; formal carrier, one-way, gears, bell/gate, NPC/chest, projectile and terrain resources; missing category rejects visual acceptance
physical_gate: Actual assembled whole-world route/resource/reward/return checks and gate bypass probes; abstract graph pass never satisfies this gate
quality_gate: Compare route choices, distinct action relationships, reward detour depth, shortcut benefit, landmark revisits and repetition; fun remains human-reviewed
